احتقبتم (form VIII)
# اِحْتَقَبْتُمْ (iḥtaqabtum) /iħ.ta.qab.tum/: second-person masculine plural past active of اِحْتَقَبَ (iḥtaqaba)
# اُحْتُقِبْتُمْ (uḥtuqibtum) /uħ.tu.qib.tum/: second-person masculine plural past passive of اِحْتَقَبَ (iḥtaqaba)
